summary: Extends the Session Description Protocol (SDP) with capability negotiation parameters and offer/answer procedures, in a backward compatible way. It allows negotiating alternative transport protocols and attributes, such as Secure RTP or different keying methods. It is a Proposed Standard.

eli5.summary: Two people pick a language to talk in. This lets the devices list what they can do and agree on the best way to talk.
